sections.title: Understanding What Is Programming?
sections.content:
## What Is Programming?

Programming is giving a computer clear, ordered instructions to complete a task. A recipe is a useful analogy: vague or missing steps can lead to the wrong result.

### Work through it carefully

Read the code from top to bottom. Identify the values, then describe what each instruction does. Compare the result with what you expected. If the result differs, inspect the relevant line and test one change at a time.

Trace the instructions in order and compare the result with your prediction.
